```{r}
#Setting data formats, calculating u and v components and correcting to SE wind component.
w2 <- w %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime2 = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime2),
         year = year(date)) %>%
  # filter(year > 2021) %>% 
  select(date, measurementTime = measurementTime2,
         ws = WindSpd_Avg, wd = WindDir_Avg) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Convert to meteorological convention (direction wind is coming FROM)
    # u = eastward component, v = northward component
    u = -ws * sin(wd * pi/180),  # Negative because wd is "from" direction
    v = -ws * cos(wd * pi/180),
    # Calculate SE component for each hourly observation
    se_component = (u - v) / sqrt(2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ws:se_component), values_to = "val", names_to = "par") %>% 
  group_by(date, par) %>%
  summarise(dm = mean(val, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Pivoting wider for joining with other data
w2_wide <- w2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "par", values_from = "dm") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate(c_sum = cumsum(se_component)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Wrangling buoy data for plotting
b2 <- b %>% 
  select(date = date_corr, fl_med_day, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
  mutate(group = as.character(group))

# Create a temporary dataset with dates of a the 2024 SB data gap.
gap_dates <- data.frame(
  date = seq(as.Date("2024-03-19"), as.Date("2024-03-24"), by = 1)
)

# Get the data surrounding the data gap and doing linear interpolation between dates.
interp_window <- b2 %>%
  filter(date >= "2024-03-15" & date <= "2024-03-30") %>%
  bind_rows(gap_dates) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    fl_med_day = na.approx(fl_med_day, na.rm = FALSE),
    # Mark interpolated points
    group = ifelse(
      date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24",
      "interpolated",
      group
    )
  )

# Merge back with original data
b24_gapfilled <- b2 %>%
  bind_rows(
    interp_window %>% filter(date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date))
```

```{r}
# Function to identify bloom periods and calculate metrics
calculate_bloom_metrics <- function(df, gap_tolerance = 0, smoothing = FALSE) {
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  bloom_summary <- data.frame()
  
  # Process each year separately
  for (yr in unique(df$year)) {
    
    year_data <- df %>% 
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      arrange(date)
    
    # Skip if insufficient data for the year
    if (nrow(year_data) < 30) {
      warning(paste("Insufficient data for year", yr, "- skipping"))
      next
    }
    
    # Optional: Apply smoothing to reduce spikiness
    if (smoothing) {
      # 3-day rolling mean to smooth spikes
      year_data$fl_smoothed <- zoo::rollmedian(year_data$fl_med_day, k = 3, 
                                            fill = NA, align = "center")
      year_data$fl_smoothed[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)] <- year_data$fl_med_day[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)]
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_smoothed
    } else {
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_med_day
    }
    
    # Calculate annual median
    annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Define bloom threshold (5% above annual median)
    bloom_threshold <- annual_median * 1.05
    
    # Identify days above threshold
    year_data$above_threshold <- comparison_var > bloom_threshold
    
    # Apply gap tolerance - fill short gaps between bloom periods
    if (gap_tolerance > 0) {
      # Find gaps of <= gap_tolerance days and fill them
      rle_result <- rle(year_data$above_threshold)
      
      # Identify short FALSE periods between TRUE periods
      for (i in 2:(length(rle_result$lengths) - 1)) {
        if (!rle_result$values[i] && rle_result$lengths[i] <= gap_tolerance &&
            rle_result$values[i-1] && rle_result$values[i+1]) {
          rle_result$values[i] <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # Reconstruct the vector
      year_data$above_threshold <- inverse.rle(rle_result)
    }
    
    # Find consecutive periods above threshold
    # Create groups of consecutive TRUE values
    year_data$group <- cumsum(c(1, diff(year_data$above_threshold) != 0))
    
    # Identify bloom periods (consecutive days >= 14 days above threshold)
    bloom_periods <- year_data %>%
      group_by(group, above_threshold) %>%
      summarise(
        start_date = min(date),
        end_date = max(date),
        duration = n(),
        max_fl = max(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_fl_date = date[which.max(fl_med_day)],
        # Additional metrics for gap-filled blooms
        days_above_threshold = sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold),
        percent_days_above = round(100 * sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold) / n(), 1),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      filter(above_threshold == TRUE & duration >= 7)
    
    # Calculate year-level metrics
    if (nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      
      # Number of bloom events
      n_bloom_events <- nrow(bloom_periods)
      
      # Spring bloom timing (first bloom of the year)
      spring_bloom_start <- min(bloom_periods$start_date)
      spring_bloom_yday <- yday(spring_bloom_start)
      
      # Annual peak chlorophyll value and timing
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      # Individual bloom event details
      bloom_events <- bloom_periods %>%
        mutate(
          year = yr,
          bloom_number = row_number(),
          start_yday = yday(start_date),
          end_yday = yday(end_date)
        ) %>%
        select(year, bloom_number, start_date, end_date, start_yday, end_yday, 
               duration, max_fl, max_fl_date, days_above_threshold, percent_days_above)
      
      # Year summary
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        n_bloom_events = n_bloom_events,
        spring_bloom_start = spring_bloom_start,
        spring_bloom_yday = spring_bloom_yday,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = sum(bloom_periods$duration)
      )
      
    } else {
      # No blooms detected for this year
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      bloom_events <- data.frame()
      
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        n_bloom_events = 0,
        spring_bloom_start = as.Date(NA),
        spring_bloom_yday = NA,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = 0
      )
    }
    
    # Store results
    if (nrow(bloom_summary) == 0) {
      bloom_summary <- year_summary
      if (exists("all_bloom_events")) {
        if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
          all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
        }
      } else {
        all_bloom_events <- bloom_events
      }
    } else {
      bloom_summary <- rbind(bloom_summary, year_summary)
      if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
        all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Return list with summary and detailed bloom events
  result <- list(
    annual_summary = bloom_summary,
    bloom_events = if(exists("all_bloom_events")) all_bloom_events else data.frame()
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```


```{r}
# Option 1: Default approach (original)
bloom_metrics_original <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled)

# Option 2: Allow 3-day gaps (recommended for spiky data) 
bloom_metrics_gap3 <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, gap_tolerance = 1,
                                              smoothing = F)

# Option 3: Use smoothing to reduce spikiness
bloom_metrics_smooth <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, smoothing = TRUE)

summary_annual <- bloom_metrics_smooth$annual_summary
summary_event <- bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events

# Option 4: Both gap tolerance and smoothing (most robust for noisy data)
bloom_metrics_robust <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, gap_tolerance = 3, smoothing = TRUE)


```

```{r}
# Create comparison visualizations showing different bloom detection approaches
library(gridExtra)

# Function to create a bloom visualization plot
create_bloom_plot <- function(year_data, bloom_events, plot_title, method_subtitle) {
  
  annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
  bloom_threshold <- annual_median * 1.05
  
  p <- ggplot(year_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day)) +
    geom_line(color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = annual_median, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", 
               alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = bloom_threshold, linetype = "solid", color = "red", 
               alpha = 0.8, size = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste(method_subtitle, "| Blooms:", nrow(bloom_events)),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Fluorescence"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  # Add bloom period rectangles
  if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(bloom_events)) {
      p <- p + annotate("rect", 
                       xmin = bloom_events$start_date[i], 
                       xmax = bloom_events$end_date[i],
                       ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
                       alpha = 0.2, fill = "red")
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
plot_year <- 2022  # Change this to any year you want to visualize

if (plot_year %in% unique(b24_gapfilled$year)) {

  p3 <- create_bloom_plot(
    year_data, 
    bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year),
    paste("Smoothed Data -", plot_year),
    "3-day rolling mean"
  )
  
  p4 <- create_bloom_plot(
    year_data, 
    bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year),
    paste("Robust Approach -", plot_year),
    "Smoothed + 3d gaps"
  )
  
  # Arrange plots in 2x2 grid
  comparison_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2_f, p3, p4, ncol = 2, 
                                 top = paste("Bloom Detection Method Comparison -", plot_year))
  
  # Also create a summary comparison table
  cat("\n=== BLOOM DETECTION COMPARISON FOR", plot_year, "===\n")
  comparison_summary <- data.frame(
    Method = c("Original", "Gap Tolerance", "Smoothing", "Robust"),
    N_Blooms = c(
      nrow(bloom_metrics_original$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_gap3$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))
    ),
    Total_Bloom_Days = c(
      sum((bloom_metrics_original$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_gap3$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
  
  print(comparison_summary)
  
}
```

```{r}
# Function to identify bloom periods and calculate metrics
calculate_bloom_metrics <- function(df, 
                                  gap_tolerance = 0, 
                                  smoothing = FALSE,
                                  min_bloom_days = 14,
                                  threshold_percent = 1.05,
                                  smoothing_period = 3,
                                  smoothing_type = "mean") {
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  bloom_summary <- data.frame()
  
  # Process each year separately
  for (yr in unique(df$year)) {
    
    year_data <- df %>% 
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      arrange(date)
    
    # Skip if insufficient data for the year
    if (nrow(year_data) < 30) {
      warning(paste("Insufficient data for year", yr, "- skipping"))
      next
    }
    
    # Optional: Apply smoothing to reduce spikiness
    if (smoothing) {
      if (smoothing_type == "mean") {
        # Rolling mean
        year_data$fl_smoothed <- zoo::rollmean(year_data$fl_med_day, k = smoothing_period, 
                                              fill = NA, align = "center")
      } else if (smoothing_type == "median") {
        # Rolling median
        year_data$fl_smoothed <- zoo::rollmedian(year_data$fl_med_day, k = smoothing_period, 
                                                fill = NA, align = "center")
      } else {
        stop("smoothing_type must be either 'mean' or 'median'")
      }
      
      # Fill NAs at edges with original values
      year_data$fl_smoothed[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)] <- year_data$fl_med_day[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)]
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_smoothed
    } else {
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_med_day
    }
    
    # Calculate annual median
    annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Define bloom threshold (customizable percentage above annual median)
    bloom_threshold <- annual_median * threshold_percent
    
    # Identify days above threshold
    year_data$above_threshold <- comparison_var > bloom_threshold
    
    # Apply gap tolerance - fill short gaps between bloom periods
    if (gap_tolerance > 0) {
      # Find gaps of <= gap_tolerance days and fill them
      rle_result <- rle(year_data$above_threshold)
      
      # Identify short FALSE periods between TRUE periods
      for (i in 2:(length(rle_result$lengths) - 1)) {
        if (!rle_result$values[i] && rle_result$lengths[i] <= gap_tolerance &&
            rle_result$values[i-1] && rle_result$values[i+1]) {
          rle_result$values[i] <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # Reconstruct the vector
      year_data$above_threshold <- inverse.rle(rle_result)
    }
    
    # Find consecutive periods above threshold
    # Create groups of consecutive TRUE values
    year_data$group <- cumsum(c(1, diff(year_data$above_threshold) != 0))
    
    # Identify bloom periods (consecutive days >= min_bloom_days above threshold)
    bloom_periods <- year_data %>%
      group_by(group, above_threshold) %>%
      summarise(
        start_date = min(date),
        end_date = max(date),
        duration = n(),
        max_fl = max(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_fl_date = date[which.max(fl_med_day)],
        # Additional metrics for gap-filled blooms
        days_above_threshold = sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold),
        percent_days_above = round(100 * sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold) / n(), 1),
        mean_fl = mean(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_fl = median(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      filter(above_threshold == TRUE & duration >= min_bloom_days)
    
    # Calculate year-level metrics
    if (nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      
      # Number of bloom events
      n_bloom_events <- nrow(bloom_periods)
      
      # Spring bloom timing (first bloom of the year)
      spring_bloom_start <- min(bloom_periods$start_date)
      spring_bloom_yday <- yday(spring_bloom_start)
      
      # Annual peak chlorophyll value and timing
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      # Individual bloom event details
      bloom_events <- bloom_periods %>%
        mutate(
          year = yr,
          bloom_number = row_number(),
          start_yday = yday(start_date),
          end_yday = yday(end_date)
        ) %>%
        select(year, bloom_number, start_date, end_date, start_yday, end_yday, 
               duration, max_fl, max_fl_date, days_above_threshold, percent_days_above,
               mean_fl, median_fl)
      
      # Year summary
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        threshold_percent = threshold_percent,
        min_bloom_days = min_bloom_days,
        gap_tolerance = gap_tolerance,
        smoothing = smoothing,
        smoothing_type = if(smoothing) smoothing_type else NA,
        smoothing_period = if(smoothing) smoothing_period else NA,
        n_bloom_events = n_bloom_events,
        spring_bloom_start = spring_bloom_start,
        spring_bloom_yday = spring_bloom_yday,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = sum(bloom_periods$duration)
      )
      
    } else {
      # No blooms detected for this year
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      bloom_events <- data.frame()
      
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        threshold_percent = threshold_percent,
        min_bloom_days = min_bloom_days,
        gap_tolerance = gap_tolerance,
        smoothing = smoothing,
        smoothing_type = if(smoothing) smoothing_type else NA,
        smoothing_period = if(smoothing) smoothing_period else NA,
        n_bloom_events = 0,
        spring_bloom_start = as.Date(NA),
        spring_bloom_yday = NA,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = 0
      )
    }
    
    # Store results
    if (nrow(bloom_summary) == 0) {
      bloom_summary <- year_summary
      if (exists("all_bloom_events")) {
        if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
          all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
        }
      } else {
        all_bloom_events <- bloom_events
      }
    } else {
      bloom_summary <- rbind(bloom_summary, year_summary)
      if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
        all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Return list with summary and detailed bloom events
  result <- list(
    annual_summary = bloom_summary,
    bloom_events = if(exists("all_bloom_events")) all_bloom_events else data.frame()
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Publication Quality Plot of Bloom Detection Results
# Shows annual fluorescence data with bloom periods and thresholds

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)

# Extract annual summary and bloom events
annual_summary <- bloom_metrics_final$annual_summary
bloom_events <- bloom_metrics_final$bloom_events

# Calculate global y-axis limits
all_data <- b24_gapfilled %>% filter(year %in% unique(annual_summary$year))
global_y_min <- 0
global_y_max <- max(all_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

# Function to create individual year plot
create_year_plot <- function(year_to_plot) {
  
  # Get year data and clean specific issues
  year_data <- b24_gapfilled %>% filter(year == year_to_plot)
  
  # Remove specific problematic data points
  if (year_to_plot == 2023) {
    year_data <- year_data %>% filter(date != as.Date("2023-12-31"))
  }
  
  # Add NA after 2025-04-27 to break line before gap
  if (year_to_plot == 2025) {
    # Find if the date exists
    if (any(year_data$date == as.Date("2025-04-27"))) {
      # Add a row with NA after 2025-04-27
      na_row <- data.frame(
        date = as.Date("2025-04-28"),
        fl_med_day = NA,
        year = 2025,
        month = 4,
        yday = yday(as.Date("2025-04-28"))
      )
      year_data <- bind_rows(year_data, na_row) %>% arrange(date)
    }
  }
  
  year_blooms <- bloom_events %>% filter(year == year_to_plot)
  year_summary <- annual_summary %>% filter(year == year_to_plot)
  
  if (nrow(year_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get threshold information
  annual_median <- year_summary$annual_median
  bloom_threshold <- year_summary$bloom_threshold
  n_blooms <- year_summary$n_bloom_events
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(year_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day)) +
    # Add bloom period rectangles first (behind the line)
    {if (nrow(year_blooms) > 0) {
      list(
        geom_rect(data = year_blooms, 
                  aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date, 
                      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                  fill = "red", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE),
        # Add bloom numbers as text
        geom_text(data = year_blooms,
                  aes(x = start_date + (end_date - start_date)/2, 
                      y = global_y_max * 0.95,
                      label = paste("B", bloom_number, sep = "")),
                  size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "darkred",
                  inherit.aes = FALSE)
      )
    }} +
    # Main fluorescence line
    geom_line(color = "#2E8B57", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Threshold lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = annual_median, 
               linetype = "dashed", color = "#4169E1", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = bloom_threshold, 
               linetype = "solid", color = "#DC143C", linewidth = 0.8) +
    # Formatting
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 months", date_labels = "%b",
                 limits = c(as.Date(paste0(year_to_plot, "-01-01")), 
                           as.Date(paste0(year_to_plot, "-12-31")))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(global_y_min, global_y_max)) +
    labs(
      title = paste(year_to_plot),
      x = "",
      y = "Fluorescence",
      subtitle = paste0("Blooms: ", n_blooms, 
                       " | Threshold: ", round(bloom_threshold, 2),
                       " | Median: ", round(annual_median, 2))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 5)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Get all available years
available_years <- sort(unique(annual_summary$year))

# Create plots for each year
year_plots <- list()
for (i in seq_along(available_years)) {
  year_plots[[i]] <- create_year_plot(available_years[i])
}

# Remove any NULL plots
year_plots <- year_plots[!sapply(year_plots, is.null)]

# Arrange plots in a grid
if (length(year_plots) > 0) {
  
  # Determine grid layout based on number of years
  n_years <- length(year_plots)
  
  if (n_years <= 2) {
    ncol <- 1
    nrow <- n_years
  } else if (n_years <= 4) {
    ncol <- 2
    nrow <- ceiling(n_years / 2)
  } else {
    ncol <- 2
    nrow <- ceiling(n_years / 2)
  }
  
  # Create the combined plot
  combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(year_plots, 
                                          ncol = ncol, 
                                          nrow = nrow,
                                          top = "Phytoplankton Bloom Detection Results"))
  
  # Print summary table
  cat("=== BLOOM DETECTION SUMMARY ===\n")
  summary_table <- annual_summary %>%
    select(year, n_bloom_events, spring_bloom_yday, annual_peak_yday, 
           total_bloom_days, annual_median, bloom_threshold) %>%
    mutate(
      spring_bloom_yday = ifelse(is.na(spring_bloom_yday), "No spring bloom", 
                                paste("Day", spring_bloom_yday)),
      annual_peak_yday = paste("Day", annual_peak_yday),
      across(c(annual_median, bloom_threshold), ~round(.x, 2))
    )
  
  print(summary_table)
  
  # Create a legend explanation
  cat("\n=== PLOT LEGEND ===\n")
  cat("Green line: Daily fluorescence measurements\n")
  cat("Blue dashed line: Annual median fluorescence\n") 
  cat("Red solid line: Bloom threshold (+15% above median)\n")
  cat("Red shaded areas: Detected bloom periods\n")
  cat("B1, B2, etc.: Bloom event numbers\n")
  cat("Method: 7-day minimum duration, 15% threshold\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No data available for plotting.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Function to add environmental data to existing bloom metrics
add_environmental_data <- function(bloom_metrics, par_data, wind_data) {
  
  # Extract bloom events from the bloom_metrics list
  bloom_events <- bloom_metrics$bloom_events
  
  # Return empty dataframe if no bloom events
  if (nrow(bloom_events) == 0) {
    cat("No bloom events found to analyze.\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  cat("Adding environmental data to", nrow(bloom_events), "bloom events...\n")
  
  # Calculate environmental averages for each bloom event
  bloom_env <- bloom_events %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # PAR metrics during bloom period
      par_mean = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        if (nrow(bloom_par) > 0) {
          mean(bloom_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      par_median = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        if (nrow(bloom_par) > 0) {
          median(bloom_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      par_min = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        if (nrow(bloom_par) > 0) {
          min(bloom_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      par_max = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        if (nrow(bloom_par) > 0) {
          max(bloom_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      par_sd = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        if (nrow(bloom_par) > 0) {
          sd(bloom_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      par_n_days = {
        bloom_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
        nrow(bloom_par)
      },
      
      # Wind speed metrics during bloom period
      wind_speed_mean = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          mean(bloom_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      wind_speed_median = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          median(bloom_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      wind_speed_max = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          max(bloom_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      wind_speed_sd = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          sd(bloom_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      
      # Wind direction (circular mean)
      wind_direction_mean = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(wd))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          # Circular mean for wind direction
          mean_u <- mean(cos(bloom_wind$wd * pi / 180), na.rm = TRUE)
          mean_v <- mean(sin(bloom_wind$wd * pi / 180), na.rm = TRUE)
          mean_dir <- atan2(mean_v, mean_u) * 180 / pi
          if (mean_dir < 0) mean_dir <- mean_dir + 360
          mean_dir
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      
      # Wind components
      u_component_mean = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(u))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          mean(bloom_wind$u, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      v_component_mean = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(v))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          mean(bloom_wind$v, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      se_component_mean = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(se_component))
        if (nrow(bloom_wind) > 0) {
          mean(bloom_wind$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      
      # Wind data availability
      wind_n_days = {
        bloom_wind <- wind_data %>% 
          filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
        nrow(bloom_wind)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  cat("Environmental data added successfully!\n")
  cat("PAR data coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$par_n_days / bloom_env$duration, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "% of bloom days\n")
  cat("Wind data coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$wind_n_days / bloom_env$duration, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "% of bloom days\n")
  
  return(bloom_env)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to analyze environmental conditions around bloom events
analyze_bloom_environmental_triggers <- function(bloom_metrics, par_data, wind_data, b_ts,
                                                pre_bloom_days = 7, 
                                                post_bloom_days = 7) {
  
  # Extract bloom events from the bloom_metrics list
  bloom_events <- bloom_metrics$bloom_events
  
  # Return empty dataframe if no bloom events
  if (nrow(bloom_events) == 0) {
    cat("No bloom events found to analyze.\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  cat("Analyzing environmental triggers for", nrow(bloom_events), "bloom events...\n")
  cat("Pre-bloom period:", pre_bloom_days, "days\n")
  cat("Post-bloom period:", post_bloom_days, "days\n")
  
  # Helper function to calculate environmental stats for a period
  calc_env_stats <- function(start_date, end_date, par_data, wind_data, b_ts, period_name) {
    
    # PAR data for period
    period_par <- par_data %>% 
      filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(dm))
    
    # Wind data for period  
    period_wind <- wind_data %>%
      filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, !is.na(ws))
    
    # Temperature and salinity data for period
    period_ts <- b_ts %>%
      filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date, 
             !is.na(mean_temp) | !is.na(mean_sal))
    
    # Calculate PAR stats
    par_stats <- if(nrow(period_par) > 0) {
      list(
        mean = mean(period_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(period_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(period_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(period_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_days = nrow(period_par)
      )
    } else {
      list(mean = NA, median = NA, max = NA, sd = NA, n_days = 0)
    }
    
    # Calculate wind stats
    wind_stats <- if(nrow(period_wind) > 0) {
      # Wind direction circular mean
      if(any(!is.na(period_wind$wd))) {
        mean_u <- mean(cos(period_wind$wd * pi / 180), na.rm = TRUE)
        mean_v <- mean(sin(period_wind$wd * pi / 180), na.rm = TRUE)
        mean_dir <- atan2(mean_v, mean_u) * 180 / pi
        if (mean_dir < 0) mean_dir <- mean_dir + 360
      } else {
        mean_dir <- NA
      }
      
      list(
        speed_mean = mean(period_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE),
        speed_median = median(period_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE),
        speed_max = max(period_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE),
        speed_sd = sd(period_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE),
        direction_mean = mean_dir,
        u_mean = mean(period_wind$u, na.rm = TRUE),
        v_mean = mean(period_wind$v, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_mean = mean(period_wind$se_component, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_days = nrow(period_wind)
      )
    } else {
      list(speed_mean = NA, speed_median = NA, speed_max = NA, speed_sd = NA,
           direction_mean = NA, u_mean = NA, v_mean = NA, se_mean = NA, n_days = 0)
    }
    
    # Calculate temperature and salinity stats
    temp_stats <- if(nrow(period_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(period_ts$mean_temp))) {
      list(
        mean = mean(period_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(period_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = min(period_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(period_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(period_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_days = sum(!is.na(period_ts$mean_temp))
      )
    } else {
      list(mean = NA, median = NA, min = NA, max = NA, sd = NA, n_days = 0)
    }
    
    sal_stats <- if(nrow(period_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(period_ts$mean_sal))) {
      list(
        mean = mean(period_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(period_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = min(period_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(period_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(period_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_days = sum(!is.na(period_ts$mean_sal))
      )
    } else {
      list(mean = NA, median = NA, min = NA, max = NA, sd = NA, n_days = 0)
    }
    
    # Combine with prefixes
    result <- c()
    names_par <- paste0("par_", period_name, "_", names(par_stats))
    names_wind <- paste0("wind_", period_name, "_", names(wind_stats))
    names_temp <- paste0("temp_", period_name, "_", names(temp_stats))
    names_sal <- paste0("sal_", period_name, "_", names(sal_stats))
    
    result[names_par] <- unlist(par_stats)
    result[names_wind] <- unlist(wind_stats)
    result[names_temp] <- unlist(temp_stats)
    result[names_sal] <- unlist(sal_stats)
    
    return(result)
  }
  
  # Calculate environmental conditions for each bloom event using a loop approach
  bloom_env_list <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(bloom_events)) {
    bloom <- bloom_events[i, ]
    
    # Calculate pre-bloom stats
    pre_stats <- calc_env_stats(bloom$start_date - days(pre_bloom_days), 
                               bloom$start_date - days(1), 
                               par_data, wind_data, b_ts, "pre")
    
    # Calculate during-bloom stats
    during_stats <- calc_env_stats(bloom$start_date, bloom$end_date, 
                                  par_data, wind_data, b_ts, "during")
    
    # Calculate post-bloom stats
    post_stats <- calc_env_stats(bloom$end_date + days(1), 
                                bloom$end_date + days(post_bloom_days), 
                                par_data, wind_data, b_ts, "post")
    
    # Combine all stats
    all_stats <- c(pre_stats, during_stats, post_stats)
    
    # Calculate changes for all variables
    par_change_pre_to_during <- all_stats[["par_during_mean"]] - all_stats[["par_pre_mean"]]
    wind_speed_change_pre_to_during <- all_stats[["wind_during_speed_mean"]] - all_stats[["wind_pre_speed_mean"]]
    temp_change_pre_to_during <- all_stats[["temp_during_mean"]] - all_stats[["temp_pre_mean"]]
    sal_change_pre_to_during <- all_stats[["sal_during_mean"]] - all_stats[["sal_pre_mean"]]
    
    par_change_during_to_post <- all_stats[["par_post_mean"]] - all_stats[["par_during_mean"]]
    wind_speed_change_during_to_post <- all_stats[["wind_post_speed_mean"]] - all_stats[["wind_during_speed_mean"]]
    temp_change_during_to_post <- all_stats[["temp_post_mean"]] - all_stats[["temp_during_mean"]]
    sal_change_during_to_post <- all_stats[["sal_post_mean"]] - all_stats[["sal_during_mean"]]
    
    # Calculate temperature and salinity gradients
    temp_gradient_pre_during <- temp_change_pre_to_during
    sal_gradient_pre_during <- sal_change_pre_to_during
    temp_range_during <- all_stats[["temp_during_max"]] - all_stats[["temp_during_min"]]
    sal_range_during <- all_stats[["sal_during_max"]] - all_stats[["sal_during_min"]]
    
    # Classify bloom type
    bloom_type <- case_when(
      bloom$bloom_number == 1 & month(bloom$start_date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring_Primary",
      bloom$bloom_number > 1 & month(bloom$start_date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring_Secondary", 
      month(bloom$start_date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      month(bloom$start_date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    )
    
    # Combine original bloom data with environmental stats
    bloom_with_env <- c(
      as.list(bloom),
      all_stats,
      list(
        par_change_pre_to_during = par_change_pre_to_during,
        wind_speed_change_pre_to_during = wind_speed_change_pre_to_during,
        temp_change_pre_to_during = temp_change_pre_to_during,
        sal_change_pre_to_during = sal_change_pre_to_during,
        par_change_during_to_post = par_change_during_to_post,
        wind_speed_change_during_to_post = wind_speed_change_during_to_post,
        temp_change_during_to_post = temp_change_during_to_post,
        sal_change_during_to_post = sal_change_during_to_post,
        temp_gradient_pre_during = temp_gradient_pre_during,
        sal_gradient_pre_during = sal_gradient_pre_during,
        temp_range_during = temp_range_during,
        sal_range_during = sal_range_during,
        bloom_type = bloom_type
      )
    )
    
    bloom_env_list[[i]] <- bloom_with_env
  }
  
  # Convert list to dataframe
  bloom_env <- do.call(rbind, lapply(bloom_env_list, function(x) as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  
  cat("Environmental trigger analysis complete!\n")
  
  # Data coverage summary
  cat("\nData coverage summary:\n")
  cat("Pre-bloom PAR coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$par_pre_n_days / pre_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Pre-bloom wind coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$wind_pre_n_days / pre_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Pre-bloom temperature coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$temp_pre_n_days / pre_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Pre-bloom salinity coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$sal_pre_n_days / pre_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Post-bloom PAR coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$par_post_n_days / post_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Post-bloom wind coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$wind_post_n_days / post_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Post-bloom temperature coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$temp_post_n_days / post_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Post-bloom salinity coverage:", round(mean(bloom_env$sal_post_n_days / post_bloom_days, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  
  return(bloom_env)
}

# Function to analyze inter-bloom periods (gaps between blooms) - enhanced with T/S
analyze_inter_bloom_conditions <- function(bloom_metrics, par_data, wind_data, b_ts) {
  
  bloom_events <- bloom_metrics$bloom_events
  
  if (nrow(bloom_events) <= 1) {
    cat("Need at least 2 bloom events to analyze inter-bloom periods.\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # Calculate inter-bloom periods for each year
  inter_bloom_results <- data.frame()
  
  for (yr in unique(bloom_events$year)) {
    year_blooms <- bloom_events %>% 
      filter(year == yr) %>% 
      arrange(start_date)
    
    if (nrow(year_blooms) <= 1) next
    
    # Calculate gaps between consecutive blooms
    for (i in 1:(nrow(year_blooms) - 1)) {
      gap_start <- year_blooms$end_date[i] + days(1)
      gap_end <- year_blooms$start_date[i + 1] - days(1)
      gap_duration <- as.numeric(gap_end - gap_start + 1)
      
      if (gap_duration > 0) {
        # Environmental conditions during gap
        gap_par <- par_data %>% 
          filter(date >= gap_start & date <= gap_end, !is.na(dm))
        gap_wind <- wind_data %>%
          filter(date >= gap_start & date <= gap_end, !is.na(ws))
        gap_ts <- b_ts %>%
          filter(date >= gap_start & date <= gap_end, 
                 !is.na(mean_temp) | !is.na(mean_sal))
        
        gap_result <- data.frame(
          year = yr,
          gap_number = i,
          gap_start = gap_start,
          gap_end = gap_end,
          gap_duration = gap_duration,
          bloom_before = i,
          bloom_after = i + 1,
          
          # PAR during gap
          par_gap_mean = if(nrow(gap_par) > 0) mean(gap_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          par_gap_median = if(nrow(gap_par) > 0) median(gap_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          par_gap_min = if(nrow(gap_par) > 0) min(gap_par$dm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          par_gap_n_days = nrow(gap_par),
          
          # Wind during gap
          wind_gap_speed_mean = if(nrow(gap_wind) > 0) mean(gap_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          wind_gap_speed_max = if(nrow(gap_wind) > 0) max(gap_wind$ws, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          wind_gap_u_mean = if(nrow(gap_wind) > 0) mean(gap_wind$u, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          wind_gap_v_mean = if(nrow(gap_wind) > 0) mean(gap_wind$v, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          wind_gap_n_days = nrow(gap_wind),
          
          # Temperature during gap
          temp_gap_mean = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_temp))) 
            mean(gap_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          temp_gap_median = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_temp))) 
            median(gap_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          temp_gap_min = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_temp))) 
            min(gap_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          temp_gap_max = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_temp))) 
            max(gap_ts$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          temp_gap_n_days = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0) sum(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_temp)) else 0,
          
          # Salinity during gap
          sal_gap_mean = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_sal))) 
            mean(gap_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          sal_gap_median = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_sal))) 
            median(gap_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          sal_gap_min = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_sal))) 
            min(gap_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          sal_gap_max = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0 && any(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_sal))) 
            max(gap_ts$mean_sal, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
          sal_gap_n_days = if(nrow(gap_ts) > 0) sum(!is.na(gap_ts$mean_sal)) else 0
        )
        
        inter_bloom_results <- rbind(inter_bloom_results, gap_result)
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("Analyzed", nrow(inter_bloom_results), "inter-bloom periods\n")
  return(inter_bloom_results)
}

# Additional helper function to summarize temperature/salinity conditions by bloom type
summarize_ts_by_bloom_type <- function(bloom_env_data) {
  
  summary_stats <- bloom_env_data %>%
    group_by(bloom_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_blooms = n(),
      
      # Temperature statistics
      temp_pre_mean = mean(temp_pre_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp_during_mean = mean(temp_during_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp_post_mean = mean(temp_post_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp_change_pre_during = mean(temp_change_pre_to_during, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp_range_during_mean = mean(temp_range_during, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Salinity statistics
      sal_pre_mean = mean(sal_pre_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      sal_during_mean = mean(sal_during_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      sal_post_mean = mean(sal_post_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      sal_change_pre_during = mean(sal_change_pre_to_during, na.rm = TRUE),
      sal_range_during_mean = mean(sal_range_during, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  return(summary_stats)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to identify favorable conditions combining ws^3 and PAR
identify_ws_cube_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = (ws^3) < 500,  # Low wind energy
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

identify_par_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      high_light = dm > 200,
      light_start = high_light & (lag(high_light, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      light_group = cumsum(light_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(high_light == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, light_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Function for combined bloom trigger periods
identify_bloom_trigger_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws) & !is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      # Both conditions: low wind energy AND sufficient light
      bloom_conditions = (ws^3) < 500 & dm > 200,
      # Only consider periods after February (yday > 32)
      post_feb = yday(date2) > 32,
      # Combined trigger condition
      trigger = bloom_conditions & post_feb,
      trigger_start = trigger & (lag(trigger, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(trigger == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      avg_wind_cube = mean(ws^3),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Function to calculate winter wind metrics and predict bloom timing
calculate_bloom_predictions <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      # Create winter groupings (Dec-Feb)
      winter_year = ifelse(month(date2) == 12, year + 1, year),
      winter_month = month(date2)
    ) %>%
    filter(winter_month %in% c(12, 1, 2)) %>%
    group_by(winter_year) %>%
    summarise(
      winter_wind_cubed_mean = mean(ws^3, na.rm = TRUE),
      winter_wind_metric = winter_wind_cubed_mean^(1/3),
      winter_wind_raw_mean = mean(ws, na.rm = TRUE),
      winter_par_mean = mean(dm, na.rm = TRUE),
      winter_n_days = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Apply the prediction equation: Day = 11.3 * <W^3>^(1/3) + Dec 30
      predicted_bloom_day = 11.3 * winter_wind_metric + 30,  # Dec 30 = day 30 of next year
      # Convert to actual date (accounting for leap years)
      predicted_date = as.Date(predicted_bloom_day, origin = paste0(winter_year - 1, "-12-31"))
    ) %>%
    rename(year = winter_year)
}

  mutate(
```

```{r}
# Function to predict spring bloom initiation for years prior to buoy data
predict_spring_bloom_initiation <- function(wind_data, par_data) {
  
  # Combine wind and PAR data
  combined_data <- wind_data %>%
    full_join(par_data, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws), !is.na(dm)) %>%  # Only days with both wind and PAR data
    arrange(year, date)
  
  # Identify first spring bloom trigger period for each year
  spring_bloom_predictions <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      # Apply validated thresholds - no date restriction
      bloom_conditions = (ws^3) < 500 & dm > 200,
      # Identify consecutive periods
      trigger_start = bloom_conditions & (lag(bloom_conditions, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(bloom_conditions == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date),
      end_date = max(date),
      duration = n(),
      avg_wind_cube = mean(ws^3),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      start_yday = yday(first(date)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Only keep periods of 6+ consecutive days (validated threshold)
    filter(duration >= 6) %>%
    # Get first qualifying period for each year (spring bloom initiation)
    group_by(year) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # First period only
    ungroup() %>%
    select(year, spring_bloom_start = start_date, bloom_duration = duration,
           bloom_start_yday = start_yday, avg_wind_energy = avg_wind_cube, 
           avg_light = avg_par)
  
  return(spring_bloom_predictions)
}

# Function to validate predictions against known buoy data (2022-2024)
validate_predictions <- function(predictions, buoy_data) {
  # Compare predicted vs observed bloom timing
  validation <- predictions %>%
    left_join(buoy_data, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(
      prediction_error_days = abs(bloom_start_yday - observed_bloom_yday)
    )
  
  return(validation)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to plot spring bloom conditions for a selected year
plot_spring_bloom_conditions <- function(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, selected_year) {
  
  # Filter data for selected year and spring months
  year_data <- wind_par_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year, month(date) %in% c(2, 3, 4))
  
  # Filter bloom periods for selected year
  bloom_periods <- bloom_periods_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year)
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- year_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
    # Add bloom period shading
    {if(nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      geom_rect(data = bloom_periods, 
                aes(xmin = spring_bloom_start, xmax = spring_bloom_start + bloom_duration,
                    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                alpha = 0.3, fill = "purple", inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }} +
    # Add wind speed cubed line (better scaling)
    geom_line(aes(y = (ws^3) / 5), color = "steelblue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Add PAR line 
    geom_line(aes(y = dm), color = "orange", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Add threshold lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = 500 / 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
    # Dual y-axis with proper scaling
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "PAR (μmol m⁻² s⁻¹)",
      limits = c(0, max(year_data$dm, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 5, name = "Wind Speed³ (m/s)³",
                         breaks = seq(0, 2500, 500))
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%b %d") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Spring Bloom Conditions -", selected_year),
      subtitle = "Purple shading: Bloom initiation periods (ws³ < 500 AND PAR > 200 for 6+ days)",
      x = "Date",
      caption = "Blue line: Wind Speed³ (right axis), Orange line: PAR (left axis)\nDashed lines: Threshold levels"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "orange"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "orange"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Example usage:
# Assuming you have:
# - wind_par_data: dataframe with columns: year, date, ws, dm
# - bloom_periods: dataframe with columns: year, spring_bloom_start, bloom_duration

# Plot for 2022
# p2022 <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods, 2022)
# print(p2022)

# Plot for 2023
# p2023 <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods, 2023)
# print(p2023)

# Or create a function to plot multiple years
plot_multiple_years <- function(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, years) {
  plots <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_along(years)) {
    plots[[i]] <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, years[i])
  }
  
  # Arrange plots in a grid
  if(length(plots) == 1) {
    return(plots[[1]])
  } else if(length(plots) == 2) {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(plots[[1]], plots[[2]], nrow = 2))
  } else if(length(plots) <= 4) {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, nrow = 2))
  } else {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, nrow = 3))
  }
}
```
